stories.title: The Bell
stories.body:
In a quiet village, an old woman rang a cracked iron bell from her garden every night at dusk.

She claimed it kept the night wolves away.

The villagers laughed.

They said there hadn’t been wolves in a hundred years.

One evening, the bell did not ring. The woman had died quietly, alone in her chair.

That night, the wolves returned, not to her house, but to the village.

They did not howl.

And when morning came, there were no footsteps in the snow.

Only teeth marks on every door.
